capability.title: Coming soon
capability.folder: Folders are coming soon. Documents are organized in a flat list in this version; folder hierarchy will arrive in a later release.
capability.importFile: File import is coming soon. You will be able to create new documents by importing CAD files.
capability.importFrom: Importing from external sources is coming soon. Third-party document imports will be supported in a later release.
capability.labelTag: Labels are coming soon. You will be able to tag documents for categorization and filtering.
capability.upgrade: Subscription upgrades are coming soon. This version uses the Free subscription; upgrading will allow creating and editing private data and inviting teammates.
capability.learning: The learning center is coming soon. It will host sample models, video tutorials, and step-by-step guides.
capability.forum: The forum is coming soon. It will host community modeling discussions.
capability.help: Help documentation is coming soon. For now, see the repository README and docs/.
